name: ask-sales-v5-10-final-promotion-gold-2026-07-27

notes: All 17 parent Slack source IDs were checked against every earlier Ask Sales test and runtime artifact and had zero matches at seal time.
Every controlling reply was read directly from Slack before the gold was written. Peer-only, unresolved, malformed, screenshot-dependent, live-status, and unrealistic prompts were excluded.

The set contains five Rich or Rich-plus-authority sources, three explicit passive-chatbot routing controls, six natural follow-up prompts, and broad policy, payment, ownership, content, operations, and channel-routing coverage.
No Slack message, reaction, draft, edit, join, invitation, or other write was performed.
This dataset is invalidated as promotion evidence if V5.10 is tuned after any runtime output is inspected.

knowledgeSnapshot: frozen V5.10 governed operational corpus and V5.9 runtime plus bounded decision-family evidence controls at the runtime freeze commit

cases.question: I'm trained as a Daymond John closer. Can I call outbound leads who applied to other ISTV shows and sell them that offer too?
cases.goldAnswer: No. A Daymond John closer should only sell the Daymond John offer unless separately trained and approved for ISTV. The offers and deliverables are different.
requiredConcepts: ISTV requires separate training or approval
forbiddenConcepts: sell any ISTV show without approval

cases.question: For daily stats when my calendar has double bookings, is scheduled calls the number of leads booked and conducted calls the number of leads who actually showed?
cases.goldAnswer: Yes. For double bookings, scheduled calls is the total number of leads booked, and conducted calls is the total number of leads who showed.
forbiddenConcepts: count only one per time slot

cases.question: Can you generate the Zoom link for my applicant's sales call?
cases.goldAnswer: The chatbot cannot generate a live Zoom link. Submit the request in the Sales Tech Requests channel.

cases.question: Before I call someone from the outbound list, do I need to check whether another rep already owns them in Keap?
cases.goldAnswer: Yes. Check Keap before calling outbound leads so you do not contact or rebook a lead already assigned to another rep.
requiredConcepts: avoid crossing an existing rep assignment

cases.question: A prospect will send the payment tomorrow morning. Should I have them sign the contract tonight and collect payment afterward?
cases.goldAnswer: No. The company process is payment first, then contract signing.

cases.question: Does a cast member on a four-payment plan have to be paid in full before the filming session?
cases.goldAnswer: No. They do not have to be paid in full before filming as long as they are not delinquent on any scheduled payment.
requiredConcepts: not required to be paid in full

cases.question: Does the VIP license place the episode on several extra platforms?
cases.goldAnswer: Not several by default. It adds one main extra-platform opportunity, Amazon Prime, and placement is not guaranteed. Apple TV submission can be purchased separately.

cases.question: A skeptical prospect wants to tour the studio before signing. Are in-person studio tours allowed?
cases.goldAnswer: No. Do not promise an in-person studio tour before signing. Use approved proof such as the virtual studio tour, articles, and past episodes instead.
requiredConcepts: use approved proof or virtual tour
forbiddenConcepts: send them to the studio unannounced

cases.question: Do I have to wait until exactly 24 hours before Call 1 to send the vital-information email?
cases.goldAnswer: No. Send it the day before the meeting; it does not need to be exactly 24 hours before, but it must be sent before 9 PM ET the night before.
forbiddenConcepts: send after 9 PM the night before

cases.question: My applicant is marked opted out in Keap but is already scheduled for Call 1 today. Should I cancel the call?
cases.goldAnswer: No. Join and run the audition normally. If they do not appear, wait five minutes, follow up by phone or text, and mark a no-show only if there is still no response.
requiredConcepts: after five minutes call or text before marking no-show
forbiddenConcepts: cancel automatically because Keap says opted out

cases.question: If a backup rep joins a pass-off call and the original rep arrives six minutes after the scheduled start, who keeps the call?
cases.goldAnswer: The original rep keeps the call because they have seven minutes from the scheduled start time to reclaim it. The backup rep should politely exit.
forbiddenConcepts: backup keeps it after five minutes
window starts when the applicant joins

cases.question: Can you confirm what a Daymond John client's first payment will say on the receipt for tax write-off purposes?
cases.goldAnswer: The chatbot should not decide or verify receipt and tax-write-off details. Submit the question in the Sales Finance Requests channel.

cases.question: Can you create and send an urgent greenlight letter for the applicant I just approved?
cases.goldAnswer: The chatbot cannot create or send a live greenlight letter. Submit the request through the Greenlight Requests process with the applicant details.

cases.question: Where should I tell a prospect to watch an Inside Success TV episode?
cases.goldAnswer: Direct them to the Inside Success TV website, the mobile app in the Apple App Store, or the TV app on Roku, Apple TV, or Fire TV devices. Do not claim an episode exists for a newer show that has not aired yet.
requiredConcepts: Roku Apple TV or Fire TV
forbiddenConcepts: tell them only to Google it
claim every casting show already has episodes

prompts.question: Can I send a prospect an episode featuring an entrepreneur in a similar industry?
prompts.goldAnswer: Yes. You may share an episode from the platform that the prospect can relate to.
requiredConcepts: may share an episode from the platform
forbiddenConcepts: promise the prospect the same results

prompts.question: Can I also tell them how well that person's episode performed so they understand the likely ROI?
prompts.goldAnswer: No. Do not share results or metrics and do not imply ROI or success. Share the episode itself without performance claims.
requiredConcepts: do not share results or metrics

prompts.question: A prospect wants to review the license options with their team. Can I email them the sales slide deck?
prompts.goldAnswer: No. Do not email the slide deck. Prefer to screen-share the approved PDF and walk them through the options on the call.
requiredConcepts: do not email the slide deck

prompts.question: What if they insist that I email something they can show the team?
prompts.goldAnswer: You may email the approved PDF as a last resort, but still do not send the slide deck. Screen-sharing and handling questions live is preferred.
requiredConcepts: approved PDF may be emailed as a last resort

prompts.question: I closed a friend who did not come through an Instagram application. Do I need a different onboarding form for this self-generated lead?
prompts.goldAnswer: No. Use the same onboarding process for a self-generated lead.

prompts.question: Is there anything different I should make sure happens because I generated the lead myself?
prompts.goldAnswer: Yes. Make sure the TEC team records the self-generated lead so you receive the 20% commission. The onboarding steps themselves stay the same.
forbiddenConcepts: commission is automatically guaranteed without recording
